oracle_details.MANOVA: Independent NumPy least-squares coefficients and residual/corrected-total SSCP; SciPy generalized symmetric eigenvalues and F survival functions. Uses JMP19.2 simple Hotelling-Lawley formula rather than statsmodels alternative McKeon convention.
oracle_details.CCA: Direct sequential Wilks/Bartlett formulas with SciPy chi-square survival probabilities; not an exact small-sample test.
oracle_details.MCA: Independent full indicator-matrix SVD rather than production standardized Burt eigendecomposition; compares full row/category Gram geometry and all inertia adjustments.
oracle_details.ML_factor: Independent SciPyL-BFGS-B on directly reconstructed Gaussian Sigma logdet+trace criterion, starting at three constantuniquenesses. Production uses a different projectedBFGS implementation and stable profiled-root criterion. Savedscore formulas checked against NumPy Sigma solves; active-boundary fixtures optimized independently.
oracle_details.dependencies: NumPy/SciPy exist only in reference harness; production adds no dependencies.
oracle_details.optional_reference_libraries: statsmodels and Rwere not used/required. No direct JMP numerical run is claimed.

limits: Whole-model numeric-design MANOVA only; no arbitrary L/M contrasts,repeated-response specification,sphericity or missing/weighteddata.
General multi-root MANOVA Fconventions are approximate; Roy p lowerbound is explicitly marked. Invalidreference degrees/nonfiniteF are null.
Canonical inference consumes complete unregularized correlation summaries; cannot detect if caller supplied regularized estimators. Bartlettreference is asymptotic.
MCA complete integer-coded categories only; no supplementary projection,weights,CochranQ or missingcategories.
MLfactor is bounded local Gaussian correlation-model likelihood; no global optimum guarantee,oblique rotations,fullidentification diagnostics,loadingSE or completeJMPfitindices.
Model-fit chi-square is asymptotic and withheld for boundary,nonconvergence,no samplecount or no positive df.
Workguard is nominal preflight plus bounded dimensions/iterations/separate eigensolver work; not a cumulative CPUinstruction ceiling.
NativeDuckDBSQLverification belongs to parent gate and is pending here.
